entry.title: HIGHLIGHTS: USA vs Spain | 2026 FIBA Women's World Cup | September 12, 2026

media:group.media:title: HIGHLIGHTS: USA vs Spain | 2026 FIBA Women's World Cup | September 12, 2026
media:group.media:description:
The USA Basketball Women’s National Team battled Spain in a back-and-forth semifinal before pulling away late for a 76-66 victory in Berlin.
After three quarters tied at 58, #USABWNT locked in defensively in the fourth, outscoring Spain 18-8 to secure the win & extend its World Cup winning streak to 35 games.
Breanna Stewart led the way with 17 points, while Jackie Young came up big down the stretch as the Americans closed out another hard-fought victory.
Now, it’s time for one more. #USABWNT will face France in an Olympic gold medal game rematch with the World Cup title on the line. 🏆🇺🇸
Watch the highlights, biggest plays & key moments from the semifinal showdown.
#USABWNT #FIBAWWC #Basketball

entry.title: Jackie Young Is On A Mission Toward Basketball History

media:group.media:title: Jackie Young Is On A Mission Toward Basketball History
media:group.media:description:
Two-time Olympic gold medalist Jackie Young has won just about everything there is to win... except the FIBA Women's World Cup.
She's on a mission in Berlin to become the first women's basketball athlete to win an NCAA championship, WNBA title, Olympic 3x3 gold medal, Olympic 5-on-5 gold medal & a World Cup gold.

entry.title: HIGHLIGHTS: USA vs Hungary | 2026 FIBA Women's World Cup | September 10, 2026

media:group.media:title: HIGHLIGHTS: USA vs Hungary | 2026 FIBA Women's World Cup | September 10, 2026
media:group.media:description:
The USA Basketball Women's National Team delivered one of its most complete performances of the 2026 FIBA Women’s World Cup, rolling past Hungary 108-56 in the quarterfinals.
The Americans set the tone early with 36 points in the first quarter before finishing with a FIBA Women’s World Cup quarterfinal-record 31 assists on 40 made field goals.
Five players finished in double figures as #USABWNT dominated from start to finish, advancing to its 11th consecutive World Cup semifinal.
Watch the highlights, biggest plays & best moments from #USABWNT’s dominant quarterfinal victory
#FIBAWWC

entry.title: HIGHLIGHTS: USA vs Czechia | 2026 FIBA Women's World Cup | September 7, 2026

media:group.media:title: HIGHLIGHTS: USA vs Czechia | 2026 FIBA Women's World Cup | September 7, 2026
media:group.media:description:
The USA Basketball Women’s National Team bounced back in a big way with a 105-70 win over Czechia to close out group play at the #FIBAWWC!
The Americans came out firing, dropping 29 points in the first quarter before finishing with 42 made field goals, 32 assists & all 12 players finding the scoring column.
Breanna Stewart led the way with 19 points, 7 rebounds & 6 assists.
Watch the highlights, biggest plays & best moments from #USABWNT’s dominant win over Czechia.
